$comment: Interface texts in English. Same keys and placeholders as ru.json.
language.name: English
banner.demo: DEMO · practice data, rules not approved.
home.title: Your preparation plan
home.scope: Deadlines are calculated for two procedures only; migration registration goes through your university. Marks are self-reported, not an official decision.
card.procedureSource: Procedure per the {uni} page: {url} (checked {date}). This is the university's rule, not the bot's calculation.
home.undated: No calculated deadline: it depends on your move-in date, see the card:
home.reminders.off: Reminders: off. Turn them on — the bot will write 7, 3 and 1 day before each date at 09:00 Moscow time and once the day after it.
card.overdue: The calculated date has passed. You still need to complete the procedure — do not put it off. The bot does not assess the consequences: ask {uni} what to do — a ready question is behind the button below.
card.docsNoSource: No official list of documents is published: always bring your passport and confirm the rest with {uni}.
calendar.intro: Your dates as a file: open it to add the events to your phone calendar. The calendar will remind you 7, 3 and 1 day before at 09:00 Moscow time, even with bot notifications off. These are calculated dates, not an official decision. After changing your marks, export again: events update instead of duplicating.
help.generic.draft: I study at {uni} and need help with __. My obstacle is __. Please explain the next step and required documents.
help.unsupported: We do not calculate unsupported cases.
help.draft: Hello! I am an international {uni} student ({who}). I need to complete “{title}”, calculated deadline {due}. The problem: ___. Could you tell me the next step and the documents I need?
help.draft.overdue: Hello! I am an international {uni} student ({who}). I need to complete “{title}”; the calculated deadline was {due} and has passed. The reason: ___. Could you tell me how to complete it now and which documents I need?
help.intro: What is in the way: a missing document, no booking, or an unclear next step? Here is a ready question for {uni}: copy it, replace ___ with your obstacle and send it yourself:
help.intro.overdue: The calculated date has passed. Do not put it off: tell {uni} and ask how to complete the procedure now. The bot does not assess the consequences and is not legal advice. A ready question: copy it, replace ___ with the reason and send it yourself:
consent: The bot stores your MAX ID, language, dates and checkmarks in its database until deletion or 400 days of inactivity. To measure usefulness it only counts daily totals of actions, without your MAX ID. Do not send passports or medical files. /delete removes your profile and queued jobs; event fingerprints expire within 7 days. This is preparation support, not legal advice. Continue?
scope: Scope: age 18+, first entry for study longer than 90 days, {uni} dormitory, no residence permit and no previously completed procedures. Entry from {from}. Does everything match? In demo, answer for a fictional student.
entry: Entry date: DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD, from {from} through today.
entry.invalid: Invalid or unsupported date. Enter DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD, from {from} through today; /help for support.
completion: Enter the actual completion date (DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD) or /today. This is self-reported, not confirmation from the authorities.
completion.invalid: Use a date between entry and today, later than the previous completion. /plan to cancel.
delete: Delete your profile, checkmarks and all pending messages?
deleted: Your data and pending messages were deleted. /start to begin again.
rulesChanged: Rules changed. Calculations are paused. Use /delete and start again.
reminder.overdue: Reminder: {title} — the calculated deadline was {due}. You still need to complete it: the card shows what to do and a ready question for your university.
ics.name: First 90 days
ics.calculated: Calculated date, not an official decision.
ics.provisional: The rule has not been legally reviewed yet.
app.title: First 90 days
app.banner.mocked: Launched without a MAX signature: local debugging, not production.
app.error.launch: This app opens from the bot in MAX. Use the button in the chat.
app.error.expired: The launch data expired. Close the app and open it from the chat again.
app.error.offline: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
app.error.server: The server could not process the action. Nothing was changed.
app.error.conflict: The data changed in another window — the screen has been refreshed.
app.error.download: Could not save the calendar file. Please try again.
app.start.title: Your mandatory procedures
app.start.body: We calculate your deadlines after entry and list the documents to collect.
app.provisional: The rule has not been reviewed by a lawyer yet — the date is provisional.
app.selfReported: Marks are self-reported, not an official decision.
app.entry.body: Entry date as DD.MM.YYYY, from {from} through today.
app.entry.invalid: Date is outside the scenario. Enter a date from {from} through today.
app.entry.future: Entry date cannot be in the future: deadlines count from your actual entry.
app.completion.body: Completion date as DD.MM.YYYY. This is self-reported, not confirmation from the authorities.
app.calendar: Add the dates to my calendar
app.scopeTitle: Let us check the scenario fits
app.done.title: All marked
app.done.body: Your after-entry procedures are marked, as reported by you. Keep the papers you were given.
app.question: Question to the university
app.copyManual: Could not copy — select the text above and copy it by hand.
poster.title: Your first 90 days in Russia
poster.lead: Get your deadlines for the medical examination and fingerprinting, with reminders
poster.scan: Point your phone camera at the code to open the bot in MAX
poster.note: The bot calculates deadlines from your entry date, reminds you and drafts a question to {uni}. It does not file documents and is not legal advice.
